problems.formal_statement:
theorem OAI.PiExponent.exists_minimum_weight
    (m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (w : Fin m → ℝ) (X : ℝ)
    (hX : ∀ i, X < w i) :
    ∃ wstar : ℝ, X < wstar ∧ (∀ i, wstar ≤ w i) ∧
      ∃ i, wstar = w i := by sorry
problems.theorem_title: A nonempty finite family of weights has an attained minimum
problems.natural_language_statement: Let m be a natural number with m ≥ 1, let w : Fin m → ℝ, and let X be real. If X < w(i) for every i, then there exists a real wstar with X < wstar, wstar ≤ w(i) for every i, and wstar = w(i) for some i.
